lines: Profile now gathers your level, your XP and your settings in one place.
Your level sits beside your name, with an XP bar. Under it: the XP to the next level, your rides, kilometres and streak.
A new rider starts at level one, with no rides and no kilometres yet.
Settings lists your bike and its state, ride settings and your custom workout, before your name and your account.
With no bike paired, the row says so and takes you to Connect Bike.
From a phone to a laptop: one column, then two, with Settings beside.
What the tests prove: the right numbers for every rider, and every row in its place.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
